Research Areas

Machine learning for graph-structured data and database systems: graph neural network architectures for incomplete, heterogeneous and temporal graphs (fraud detection, malware detection, graph similarity computation), and learning-based methods that accelerate database and data-mining algorithms.
Keywords: Graph Neural Networks, Graph Databases, AI for Databases, Fraud Detection, Knowledge Graphs
